searchText: Since transactions in the block include blob versioned hashes, I think blob building has to be a builder responsibility. So the builder bid will need to include `blob_kzg_commitments` , and the revealed payload will have to include the blobs and kzg proof Well, the proposer no longer needs to sign over the sidecar. I think the most simple interaction is just to have the relayer broadcasts the `SignedBeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecar` and `submitBlindBlock` returns the `SignedBeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecar` What do you have in mind that the validator should do with the returned `blob_kzg_commitments` from `bid`? Agree on this This so that it can include it in the block and create a valid signature over the block can't do any validation on it otherwise Hello everyone, sorry if this is not the appropriate channel to ask this, i am joining EFP as a permisonless candidate , i got interested by EIP4844 especially data-availability sampling & (Blob space, KZG-commitments) i read enough docs to get a clear idea about the process but i still not figure out the repos or implementations to explore in detail, check for issues and give my help i have solid knowledge in C and C++ and whiling to learn any new language please anyone can point me to some resources where i dive deep into the points mentioned above , thanks in advance & all the best This would be a good place to start, it includes tracking for each client, although not sure if it's out of date https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Breakout-Room/4844-readiness-checklist.md
